**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is thinking of hosting a game night at their place.  
[FACT] User's coworkers had a blast playing Codenames last Thursday and won both rounds.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to ensure a good mix of games for the game night.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Codenames is an amazing game.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended games similar to Codenames: Taboo, Deception, Mysterium, The Resistance, Wits & Wagers, Spyfall, Decrypto, Just One.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Taboo is a classic word-guessing game that involves describing a word without using certain "taboo" words or phrases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deception is a social deduction game where one player is a spy, and others must figure out who it is.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mysterium is a cooperative game where one player is a ghost trying to communicate with others to solve a murder mystery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Resistance is a social deduction game where players work together to complete missions while some may be spies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wits & Wagers is a trivia game that encourages players to bet on answers given by opponents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Spyfall is a fast-paced question-and-answer game where players ask questions to identify a spy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Decrypto is a word-guessing game where players decipher encrypted messages.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Just One is a cooperative game where players describe a concept without using forbidden words.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to consider the number of players, playtime, and complexity level when selecting games.  
[EVENT] User is hosting a game night specifically for coworkers.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers games that are easy to learn and play.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of Taboo and Deception.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Taboo has a playtime of 30-60 minutes and is suitable for 4-12 players (best with 6-8).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deception has a playtime of 20-40 minutes and is suitable for 4-12 players (best with 6-8).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Taboo is very easy to learn, while Deception is easy to learn but requires some strategic thinking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both games are great for a group of 8-10 coworkers, and user can divide into two teams.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks Taboo is a great icebreaker game that everyone can enjoy.  
[EVENT] User introduced coworkers to Codenames during lunch break on Thursday.
